text: ポケモン　ずかん　つくってる　ようじゃ　だめだ！

structure.jp: ポケモン　ずかん　つくってる　ようじゃ
structure.en: if making a Pokédex is all you're doing

patterns.name: 〜ようでは
patterns.span: つくってる　ようじゃ　だめだ
patterns.explanation: ようでは after a verb means 'if that's how things are', and a bad result always follows. じゃ is the spoken short form of では. つくってる　ようじゃ　だめだ = 'if you're just making it, that's no good'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now. てる is the short spoken form. つくってる = 'are making'.
